facts.fact: Stuut sells an AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for enterprises, covering order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions.

Stuut raised a $52.5M Series B announced 2026-10-07, led by Insight Partners with a16z and M12 participating, for $93M total funding; the article reports over 150 customers and a 47% DSO reduction, which are Stuut's own claims, and more than $3B has moved through the platform.
A Form D filed 2026-09-16 shows a $67.6M round size, which is larger than the announced $52.5M Series B; this gap was not reconciled and is not independently verified.
